question.prompt: Martians measure angles in clerts. There are \(500\) clerts in a full circle. How many clerts are there in a right angle?

solutions.explanation:
Four equal right angles make a full circle. Therefore a right angle measures one fourth of the full circle, regardless of the angle unit used. In clerts, its measure is
\[500\div4=125.\]
The answer is \(125\) clerts, choice C.
solutions.title: A quarter of a circle
